risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity risks, including data loss and unauthorized access. A significant cybersecurity incident in September 2023 caused operational disruptions. The appointment of a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) demonstrates that this risk is taken seriously at the board level. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly regulated sector. Major changes in gaming law in Macao in 2022, including a maximum 10-year concession limit, demonstrate significant regulatory exposure. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector. The non-renewal of the commercial gaming license for Empire City in 2025 and the sale of several properties (The Mirage, Gold Strike Tunica, MGM Northfield Park) reflect competitive pressure. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology to operate its gaming and hotel activities. Technical failures could impact operations. Cybersecurity infrastructure is being strengthened with an ongoing search for a new CISO. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant operations in Asia, particularly in Macao through MGM China (56% ownership). Changes in regional geopolitical conditions could affect operations and visitor demand. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is a large enterprise operating in a regulated sector and could be exposed to litigation. The mention of a 2023 cybersecurity incident could potentially lead to claims. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: The company faces reputational risks related to cybersecurity, gaming operations, and its ability to attract customers. The 2023 cybersecurity incident resulted in remediation costs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Financial and Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has adopted an asset-light model and generated $17.5 billion in revenue in 2025. Changes in market conditions could affect demand and profitability. Property sales reflect active portfolio management. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: MGM Resorts International does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, operations, and business segments without reference to AI or related technology.
